subject: Level anchors primer, market exceptions, and approval checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-07-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Level anchors primer, market exceptions, and approval checklist

Team — attaching the latest snapshot and a short primer on the level anchors and the two requested market exceptions. High-level asks below: 

1) Please confirm (by EOD Fri 7/30) whether you sign off on the proposed anchors for IC3/IC4 and MGR1/2 in US/EU. The CSV has the proposed mid and spread per level.
2) Approve two exceptions: (a) SDE-III anchor uplift for APAC hires (+8% local uplift) and (b) Sales AE target bandaid for Q4 urgent hires (flat-rate override). Both have headcount and budget impacts called out in sheet.
3) If approved, I will route the final artifacts to PeopleOps for formal headcount and offer guardrail sign-off — want to submit by 8/4 to meet recruiting timelines.

Notes: Mercer provided updated market percentiles — I pulled 50/65/80 for core benchmark positions. The CSV attached includes raw comp, currency conversion notes, and a simple sensitivity table. Also linking the playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A.../Comp-Playbook

Attachments: band_market_snapshot_0727.csv, level_anchor_proposal_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Level anchors primer, market exceptions, and approval checklist

Jordan — quick read-through below. Inline where helpful.

On Tue, Jul 27, 2027 at 3:12 PM Jordan Blake wrote:
> Team — attaching the latest snapshot and a short primer on the level anchors and the two requested market exceptions.

1) IC3/IC4 anchors look directionally right for US engineering roles. My ask: add a note in the playbook about the anchored on-target vs total comp for progressive bands — we shouldn't assume OTE parity across disciplines.
2) APAC uplift: +8% seems aggressive for SDE-III in SEA markets. Can we ask Mercer to break APAC into SEA (SG/IN) and ANZ (AU/NZ) buckets? I expect ANZ needs the lift, SEA likely lower.
3) Sales AE override: okay to pilot for Q4 but require a 6-month review clause and written justification in the candidate packet.

I also want a short paragraph summarizing the benchmarking methodology in the proposal doc (percentiles used, sources, currency conversion approach). That will make it easier during audit or when managers push back.

I'll approve conditionally for US/EU anchors once Mercer provides APAC breakout and we add the methodology blurb.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@mercer.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T14:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Level anchors primer, market exceptions, and approval checklist

Hi Jordan / Laura — thanks for the data. A few clarifications from Mercer (summary here, full PDF attached as "mercer_benchmark_notes_0729.pdf"):

• Data sources: combination of Mercer compensation surveys (tech cohort), Glassdoor anonymized comps for smaller markets, and proprietary SaaS market sample. We used employer-reported base + target bonus where available.
• Percentiles: Your current proposal uses 50/65/80. For high-velocity hiring (Sales, Security), we recommend anchoring at 65/75 to improve offer success; for core engineering, 50/65 is defensible.
• APAC split: Agreed — ANZ should be treated separately. SEA (India, Singapore) sample sizes vary; recommended uplift for SDE-III: ANZ +9% vs US mid, SEA +4% vs US mid (currency-adjusted).
• Currency conversion: We used a 6-month trailing FX average to smooth volatility (documented in the attached PDF).
• Method notes: See page 3 of the PDF for edge-case handling (contractors vs full-time equivalence, equity sampling).

Happy to run a quick 30-min walkthrough with hiring and recruiting if you want to kick the decision to managers.

Best,
Sofia
Mercer Compensation Services

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@mercer.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final decisions and routing for headcount / offer guardrails

Thanks all — summary and next steps (final):

Decisions: 
• Approve US/EU anchors as proposed in band_market_snapshot_0727.csv (Laura: conditional approval accepted after method blurb added).
• APAC anchors: adopt Mercer's ANZ +9% and SEA +4% recommendations for SDE-III; I asked Mercer to add those numbers into the proposal sheet (see attached PDF).
• Sales AE Q4 override: approve pilot with 6-month review clause; recruiting to include written justification for each overridden offer.

Action items:
1) Jordan — update playbook with 2-paragraph methodology blurb and embed Mercer's PDF (due 8/4).
2) Tessa — open headcount request packets for the approved roles and route to Finance for budget release (target 8/5). Include a note on projected burn impact for Q3/Q4.
3) Laura — once Jordan updates docs, route final artifacts to PeopleOps approvals queue; we will request expedited review so recruiting can proceed.
4) Mercer (Sofia) — please add the APAC breakout to the CSV and confirm percentile adjustments in a final PDF (requested by 8/2, received 7/29 — thanks).

Attachments: mercer_benchmark_notes_0729.pdf (attached by Sofia), band_market_snapshot_0727.csv, level_anchor_proposal_v2.xlsx

Will follow up with the PeopleOps ticket number and the recruiting priority list. Thanks for the quick turnaround — this keeps offers on schedule.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference
